places.name: Charminar
places.ai_summary: A historic monument and mosque, symbolizing the city of Hyderabad, known for its stunning architecture and bustling surroundings.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Explore the nearby Laad Bazaar for bangles and souvenirs.

attribution.title: A typical charminar evening
attribution.author: Vivekanand pokala
attribution.description: Panorama of Charminar and surroundings which consist of Charminar Bazar, Mekkah Masjid, Nizamia Unani hospital and Laad Bazaar.

places.name: Golconda Fort
places.ai_summary: A majestic fort with a rich history, offering panoramic views of Hyderabad and a famous sound and light show.

opening_hours.notes: Sound and light show timings vary; check locally.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for climbing the fort.

attribution.title: Aerial view of Golconda fort
attribution.author: Aarjithdavis
attribution.description: This is a photo of ASI monument number

places.name: Hussain Sagar Lake & Buddha Statue
places.ai_summary: A serene lake with a massive Buddha statue in the center, offering boat rides and picturesque views.

opening_hours.notes: Evening boat rides are popular.

places.place_tip: Take a boat ride to the Buddha statue for a closer view.
places.address: Hussain Sagar Lake, Hyderabad, Telangana, India

places.name: Ramoji Film City
places.ai_summary: The world's largest film city, offering a glimpse into the Indian film industry with live shows, sets, and attractions.
places.cost: ₹1,200 for Indians, ₹2,500 for foreigners (includes studio tour and lunch)

opening_hours.notes: Pre-booking is highly recommended, especially on weekends.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the live action shows and the chance to explore film sets.
places.address: Ramoji Film City, Hyderabad, Telangana, India

attribution.description: The Flag of India. The colours are saffron, white and green. The navy blue wheel in the center of the flag has a diameter approximately the width of the white band and is called Ashoka's Dharma Chakra, with 24 spokes (after Ashoka, the Great). Each spoke depicts one hour of the day, portraying the prevalence of righteousness all 24 hours of it.

places.name: Salar Jung Museum
places.ai_summary: One of the three National Museums of India, housing an extensive collection of art, antiques, and artifacts from around the world.
places.cost: Free entry; special exhibits may have a fee

opening_hours.notes: Plan for at least 2-3 hours to explore the museum.

places.place_tip: Check out the museum's clock and the marble gallery.
places.address: Salar Jung Museum, Hyderabad, Telangana, India

places.name: Chowmahalla Palace
places.ai_summary: A beautiful palace showcasing the architectural grandeur of the Nizams, with stunning gardens and a collection of vintage cars.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours are available and recommended.

places.place_tip: Visit the vintage car museum within the palace complex.

places.name: Birla Mandir
places.ai_summary: A stunning white marble temple dedicated to Lord Venkateswara, offering panoramic views of the city.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited early morning or evening.

places.place_tip: Dress modestly and be prepared for a security check.

places.name: Qutb Shahi Tombs
places.ai_summary: The royal tombs of the Qutb Shahi dynasty, set in a serene landscape with impressive architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Explore the gardens and the various tombs in the complex.
places.address: Qutb Shahi Tombs, Hyderabad, Telangana, India

places.name: Laad Bazaar (Choodi Bazaar)
places.ai_summary: A vibrant market famous for its bangles, especially the traditional Hyderabadi lac bangles.
places.cost: Free to enter; cost of bangles varies

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening; closed on Sundays.

places.place_tip: Bargain wisely and explore side lanes for unique finds.

places.name: Mecca Masjid
places.ai_summary: One of the largest mosques in India, known for its impressive architecture and serene courtyard.

opening_hours.notes: Dress modestly and remove shoes before entering.

places.place_tip: Visit the nearby Chowmohalla Palace if time permits.

places.name: Lumbini Park
places.ai_summary: A tranquil park ideal for relaxation, featuring a large Buddha statue and musical fountain.

opening_hours.notes: Evening musical fountain show is a highlight.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with Hussain Sagar Lake.

places.name: Nehru Zoological Park
places.ai_summary: A large zoo with a wide variety of animals and birds, set in a lush green environment.

opening_hours.notes: Plan your visit to catch the animal feeding sessions.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes and carry water.
places.address: Nehru Zoological Park, Hyderabad, Telangana, India

places.name: Snow World
places.ai_summary: An indoor snow park offering a unique experience of snow and ice in the city, with various snow activities.

opening_hours.notes: Wear warm clothes; they are not provided at the venue.

places.place_tip: Try the snow slides and the ice skating rink.

places.name: Shilparamam Crafts Village
places.ai_summary: An arts and crafts village showcasing traditional Indian handicrafts, with workshops and a vibrant market.
places.cost: Entry free; cost of handicrafts varies

opening_hours.notes: Check for any cultural programs or workshops.

places.place_tip: Interact with artisans and explore the food stalls.

places.name: Tank Bund Promenade
places.ai_summary: A popular boulevard around Hussain Sagar Lake, ideal for a leisurely walk, with views of the lake and city.

opening_hours.notes: Evening visits offer a chance to see the sunset by the lake.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to Lumbini Park or Hussain Sagar Lake.

places.name: NTR Gardens
places.ai_summary: A public park named after N.T. Rama Rao, featuring gardens, a lake, and various recreational activities.

opening_hours.notes: Ideal for a family picnic or a leisurely stroll.

places.place_tip: Check out the Japanese Garden and the cactus garden.

places.name: Birla Planetarium & Science Museum
places.ai_summary: A popular science museum and planetarium, offering interactive exhibits and shows about space and science.

opening_hours.notes: Check the schedule for planetarium show timings.

places.place_tip: Engage in the interactive science exhibits.

places.name: Jalavihar Water Park
places.ai_summary: A popular water park with a variety of slides, wave pools, and other water attractions.

opening_hours.notes: Best to visit during the summer months.

places.place_tip: Arrive early to avoid crowds and secure a good spot.
places.address: Jalavihar Water Park, Hyderabad, Telangana, India

places.name: Sudha Car Museum
places.ai_summary: A unique museum displaying a private collection of over 150 vintage and classic cars.

opening_hours.notes: Check for any special events or exhibitions.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the rare and vintage car models.
places.address: Sudha Car Museum, Hyderabad, Telangana, India

places.name: Banjara/Jubilee Hills Food Streets
places.ai_summary: Famous food streets offering a variety of local and international cuisines, popular for their vibrant atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening; try to avoid late-night visits.

places.place_tip: Explore different stalls for a variety of flavors.
